name: Spotted Harrier
rangeDescription: Sulawesi, sula islands, eastern lesser sundas, and australia
description: Long-legged medium-sized raptor with long narrow wings. Adult has chestnut underparts with striking white spots; immature streaked below.

name: Henst's Goshawk
rangeDescription: Forest and savanna of madagascar (except central and far southern)
description: A big, powerful goshawk. Adults are gray on the back with fine gray barring below; females much larger.

name: Rufous-necked Wood-Rail
rangeDescription: Coastal northwestern mexico to trinidad and suriname, and to far northwestern peru
description: Elusive, chickenlike rail of mangroves, less often occurs in freshwater marshes. Slightly smaller than a Common Gallinule.

name: Humboldt's Sapphire
rangeDescription: Far southeastern panama to colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: Fairly small hummingbird with limited range near the coast from extreme southeast Panama to northwest Ecuador. Males are distinctive: mostly green with a bluish crown and throat, white undertail coverts, and a white stripe up the belly.

name: Dot-fronted Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Humid andean slopes of southern bolivia and northwestern argentina
description: Small greenish woodpecker of the dry and semi-humid forests at the base of the Andes in NW Argentina and southern Bolivia. Male has a red cap, while the female’s head is grayish with pale spots.

name: Violet-capped Woodnymph
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil to eastern paraguay and northeastern argentina
description: Common hummingbird of both montane and lowland forests and woodlands. Also visits feeders and gardens.

name: Groove-billed Ani
rangeDescription: Southern baja california; southern texas through central and south america (including curaçao and trinidad) to northern chile and northern argentina
description: Anis are bizarre, coal-black cuckoos with long floppy tails and unique, curiously tall, flattened bills. Groove-billed occurs in a variety of open and semi-open habitats in tropical lowlands and foothills, typically staying low in shrubs and grasses.

name: Golden-chevroned Tanager
rangeDescription: Southeastern brazil (southern bahia to eastern minas gerais and santa catarina)
description: Large blue and yellow tanager with a thinner bill than other similar species. Males are mostly blue with yellowish edges to the wing feathers and tail.

name: Eye-ringed Parrotbill
rangeDescription: Southern china (southern sichuan and northern yunnan)
description: Gregarious long-tailed little bird. Restricted to southwestern China and adjacent northern Myanmar, where it inhabits grassy and scrubby areas, as well as bamboo stands and secondary growth, in mountains and foothills.

name: Many-banded Aracari
rangeDescription: Northeastern colombia to southern venezuela, northeastern peru, and northwestern amazonian brazil
description: Fairly small toucan found in northwestern Amazonia. Often the most common speices of aracari within its range.

name: Green-throated Euphonia
rangeDescription: Lowlands of eastern paraguay to southeastern brazil and northeastern argentina
description: Tiny bird with a strong thick bill and a short tail. Males are mostly glossy dark greenish-blue with a yellow band on the forehead and are entirely yellow below.

name: Splendid Sunbird
rangeDescription: Senegal to sierra leone, eastward to southern nigeria, cameroon, central african republic, northeastern democratic republic of the congo, and southwestern south sudan; nonbreeding visitor to northeastern gabon
description: A fairly large, long-billed sunbird in which males and females are very different. Males are dark, with an iridescent multi-colored hood and a black belly.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Marañon Spinetail
rangeDescription: Southern ecuador (zamora-chinchipe) to northwestern peru (northern cajamarca)
description: Very shy spinetail restricted to the Marañon Valley of northwestern Peru and extreme southern Ecuador; highly threatened due to ongoing habitat loss. Plumage is mostly gray with chestnut back, wings, and tail.

name: Red-backed Flameback
rangeDescription: Central and southern sri lanka
description: Widespread, medium-sized woodpecker with a bright red back and three toes. Endemic to Sri Lanka.

name: Lazuli Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Southern moluccas (ambon, seram, and haruku)
description: A stunning blue-and-white kingfisher with entirely blue upperparts in both sexes. Female has white throat and pale blue breast and belly, but male shows more white, with pale blue confined to belly.

name: Sumba Hornbill
rangeDescription: Sumba (lesser sundas)
description: A small black hornbill with an ivory-colored bill that has a reddish smudge at the base and a knob on top. There is a pale blue pouch of skin below the bill.

name: Naga Wren-Babbler
rangeDescription: Hill forest of nagaland and northern manipur
description: A tiny bird that skulks in the dense undergrowth of evergreen forests, particularly around running water. Brown above with a large white throat patch and belly.

name: Stripe-cheeked Greenbul
rangeDescription: Malawi (mount mulanje) to western mozambique and zimbabwe
description: Large chunky, olive-green greenbul. The crown is gray, and there is a white arc above the eye, and a dark cheek with fine white stripes, though these can be hard to see.

name: Velvet-purple Coronet
rangeDescription: Western andes of southwestern colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: This medium-sized hummingbird looks all blackish in poor light, but at the right angle, it turns into a dazzling gem with a purple belly and crown, turquoise sides, and greenish wing coverts. Note bright white flashes in the tail.

name: Lady Amherst's Pheasant
rangeDescription: Mountains of southeastern tibet and southwestern china to northern myanmar
description: Attractive terrestrial bird of hilly forests with dense patches of undergrowth. Stately male is resplendent, with long striped tail, white belly, and black-and-white scaling on neck.
